audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart and prose disagree: content win[4] gave Level 6 to Ryze while the prose calls 6 Gwen's spike, and win[6] gave 2+ items to Gwen while whys[6] says Ryze is the raid boss.
audit.why: Packet levelChart (Ryze/Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Ryze) matches the prose; the stored chart did not.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Gwen, 2+ items -> Ryze, in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike rows were generic template text with no ability names or timings.
audit.why: Gwen's real spikes here are Level 3 (Hallowed Mist), Level 6 (Needlework), Riftmaker; Ryze's is two items of Flux-empowered Overload resets.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now names the actual ability and what it does.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers called Rune Prison a 'point-and-click root you cannot dodge'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Rune Prison damages and SLOWS; it only roots if the target already has Flux (Spell Flux, E) on them. Spell Flux is the real tell. Both W and E are targeted at 615 range, so Hallowed Mist (which can only be targeted by enemies inside it) denies both outright.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux; bait the E. Both casts are targeted at 615, so from outside your Mist he cannot cast either.
Added both to the cooldown and don't sections.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Ryze contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Overload (Q) outranges everything you own at 1000 units and you have no Mist yet. Soak XP at the cone tip and skip last hits you cannot reach.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Ryze's Rune Prison is down.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash opens the window. Rune Prison roots only after Spell Flux lands — trade when he spends E.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ryze must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist lands. Rune Prison and Spell Flux are both targeted at 615, so from outside the fog he cannot cast either on you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Rune Prison's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Rune Prison is gone for 9-11s after every cast — that gap is your step-up. E in, snip the true-damage centre, Mist his answer, walk out.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Needlework ramps over three casts and slows him out of kiting range, and Realm Warp is no combat ultimate — six is your kill window, not his.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Rune Prison's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — force the fight the moment it completes, while his bar is still squishy.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ryze carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Ryze takes over: Flux-empowered Overload resets fire off cooldown and burst you long before you reach Mist range. Close the game out now.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison (9-11s): only roots if Spell Flux is already on you — dodge the E and the W is just a slow. Track it before every engage. - Skip 'n Slash: never spend it on chip. - Needlework: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Ryze with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Ryze wastes Rune Prison — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Ryze with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Ryze spends Spell Flux on a minion — his W cannot root, so commit everything. Bad trade: standing outside the Mist inside his 615 range, where every targeted cast lands for free.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It only roots through Spell Flux (E). Bait the E out, then engage — a bare W is just a slow.

edits.before: Ryze wastes Rune Prison — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Targeted at 615 — from outside the mist he cannot cast it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Burning it for chip leaves you naked for a full 18-22s cooldown.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — Q-snip in the mist.
edits.after: Rune Prison only roots a target already carrying Spell Flux, and both are targeted at 615 — inside Mist he can cast neither.

edits.before: Ryze pokes with Overload (Q) line-skillshots and can point-and-click root you with Rune Prison (W) for a free combo — you have no Mist and no E dash yet to answer it.
edits.after: Ryze pokes with Overload (Q) lines and roots you with Rune Prison (W) — but only once Spell Flux (E) is on you, and you have no Mist and no E dash yet to answer it.

edits.before: Ryze outranges you with Overload (Q) and his Rune Prison (W) is a point-and-click root — with no Mist and no Skip 'n Slash dash you cannot trade or dodge, so he chunks you for free.
edits.after: Ryze outranges you with Overload (Q) at 1000 units and Rune Prison (W) roots once Spell Flux tags you — with no Mist and no Skip 'n Slash dash you cannot answer, so he chunks you for free.

edits.before: At 6 your Hallowed Mist makes his root combo whiff — drop Mist as he roots and his follow-up Q fires into the fog while you stay untargetable and keep snipping.
edits.after: At 3 Hallowed Mist arrives — Rune Prison and Spell Flux are both targeted at 615, so from outside the fog he cannot cast either and his combo has no opener.

edits.before: Needlework plus Mist lets you eat his W, go untargetable, then slow-chase him down while your passive and ability healing out-sustain his poke.
edits.after: Rune Prison is down 9-11 seconds after each cast; step up in that gap, dash in, snip the true-damage centre, and let passive healing out-sustain his poke.

edits.before: Riftmaker or Nashor's makes Snip Snip! lethal on his squishy bar — drop W on his root, dash in with Skip 'n Slash, and %-max-HP damage out-trades his Q.
edits.after: Needlework's three casts ramp and slow him out of kiting range, and Realm Warp is no combat ultimate — six is your kill window, so Mist his W and commit.

edits.before: Ryze owns these levels — his Overload (Q) line outranges everything you have, and his Rune Prison (W) is a point-and-click root you cannot dodge, so every time you step up to last-hit he can root you and free-cast Q poke. You have no Mist and no Skip 'n Slash dash yet, so soak XP at max range, take the poke, and do NOT walk into a W root with no flash up. The one comfort: his early Q poke can't out-pace your passive healing once you start trading back, and he has no real kill pressure on you until he lands a root with jungle help or near his tower.
edits.after: Ryze owns these levels — his Overload (Q) line outranges everything you have at 1000 units, and Rune Prison (W) roots you the moment Spell Flux (E) is on you, so every step up to last-hit risks a rooted Q combo. You have no Mist and no Skip 'n Slash dash yet, so soak XP at max range, take the poke, and never walk up while his E is off cooldown. The one comfort: his early Q poke can't out-pace your passive healing once you start trading back, and he has no real kill pressure until he lands E-into-W with jungle help or near his tower.

notes: Content win[] and full phases[] both disagreed with the packet levelChart at Level 6 and 2+ items; I aligned both to the packet chart, which also matches the existing prose (whys[6] already said Ryze is the late-game raid boss). Rune Prison was described as an undodgeable point-and-click root in three places — per Riot's own text it is a damage+slow that only roots through Spell Flux.
